title: Add support for RayHunter to Waveshare SIM7600G-H
body:
### What problem does this feature solve or what does it enhance?

This ticket is a request to add support for RayHunter for the Waveshare SIM7600G-H, which is a popular cellular modem module, and is the built-in cellular-modem option for the ClockworkPi uConsole.

It seems like the SIM7600G-H is compatible with the ADB bridge, although I am not an expert in usage of ADB in linux.

This would possibly also involve making a UI element of some sort for supporting linux machines.

### Proposed Solution

* Adding the support for great justice

### Alternatives Considered

* I considered taping my orbic to the back of my uConsole instead, seems kinda bulky
